name: Identity, representation and scope
information: Principal, organization, patient/case IDs, purpose, representation, resource permissions.
contract: Authorization checks and scoped identity matches; no role prompt can bypass the gate.

name: Clinical record and evidence
information: Versioned source notes, orders, observations, diagnostic reports and document provenance.
contract: Reads and attributed writes follow assigned operation scope; agents cannot create unobserved test results.

name: Policy and criteria registry
information: Product/jurisdiction/setting/version/effective-date rules and approval history.
contract: Ordinary workers read; approved governance controls change versions.

name: Coverage and benefit facts
information: Enrollment/benefit snapshots, requirements and administrative determinations.
contract: Product-specific administrative scope; not clinical necessity or payment assurance.

name: Provider authorization workspace
information: Requests, packet versions, submissions, RFIs and provider disputes.
contract: Versioned mutation, stable action identity and observable submission/receipt.

name: Payer review and appeal workspace
information: Intake/review episodes, qualification/assignment, determination and appeal state.
contract: Actual stage/route and signoff envelope; no universal forced stage sequence.

name: Conversation and correspondence
information: Patient, representative, clinician and interorganization exchanges.
contract: Preserve speaker, actual observed answer, scope, channel, status and reply correlation.

name: Care journey and obligations
information: Assessments, goals, plan contributions, outreach and follow-up ownership.
contract: Attributed updates with unknowns, refusal and pending/exception dispositions.

name: Referrals and resource directory
information: Receiving providers, community supports, service eligibility and acceptance.
contract: Resource listing, referral, acceptance and actual fulfillment remain distinct.

name: Capacity, staffing and scheduling
information: Beds, slots, shifts, resources, reservations and waitlists.
contract: No double allocation; reservations/expiry follow only exposed authoritative version/time semantics.

name: Service fulfillment and delivery
information: Visits, transport, supplies, placement, administration and no-shows.
contract: Only environment/service events establish delivery; a plan or actor narration alone cannot.

name: Artifacts, notices and delivery
information: Draft/final packet, note, plan, handoff, notice and delivery receipt.
contract: Author/source/decision/version link; draft, final and delivered are separate.

name: Scoped memory and retrieval
information: Per-actor/case working context, episodes, policy/procedure knowledge and indexes.
contract: Scope/trust/provenance filters before injection and delegation; index freshness explicit.

name: Action journal and recovery
information: Intents, canonical payload hashes, attempts, receipts, unknown outcomes and replay.
contract: Stable intent keys, actual receiver contract, fenced publication and reconciliation.

name: Work events, queues and task clock
information: Observed task events, internal timers, deadlines and waiting obligations.
contract: Use actual task/environment time where exposed; do not advance a fictional hospital clock.

name: Audit and observability
information: Permitted action/source/context/usage trace and aggregate operational metrics.
contract: Separate actor-visible diagnostics from hidden oracle/debug data; retention/purpose apply.

name: Actor assignments and authority
information: People/positions, recorded role/task scope, delegation, scope, ownership and conflicts.
contract: Distinct organization/decision domains; policy-configured independence and actual assignment checks.

name: Benchmark boundary and evaluation output
information: Supplied task input/tool contracts and separate post-run result receipts.
contract: No acting prompt/tool may query hidden expected answers; official grading remains outside our acting organization.

name: Clinical evidence and diagnostic interfaces
information: Supplied clinical observations, orders, diagnostic evidence and exposed service results.
contract: No physiology/world engine: accept actual observations and distinguish a new review judgment from an invented test result.

name: Billing, assistance and payment
information: Estimates, assistance applications, claims, adjudication and observed payment.
contract: Not inferred from authorization; financial outcomes require their own service evidence.
